rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables remote read/write access to Obsidian vaults over HTTPS using Streamable HTTP transport. Provides nine tools for file operations, full-text search, frontmatter indexing, and directory management. Secured with OAuth 2.0 (PKCE), path traversal prevention, and atomic writes. Supports deployment via Cloudflare Tunnel for outbound-only connectivity without exposing inbound ports.
